job.name: l5_board_b
job.meaning: Дизайн-система для ролика «Приветствие директора RU+EN»: ГЛОБАЛЬНЫЙ КОБАЛЬТ: насыщенный ультрамарин, белый, небесно-голубой, сигнальный оранжевый; Space Grotesk + Inter; карта мира из точек, дуги связей, чипы языков, сплит-экраны; динамичный современный стиль; ведущая в белой рубашке на кобальтовом фоне; 6 вертикальных раскладок
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet, 16:9) for SHORT VERTICAL 9:16 corporate videos of a fictional international company «Меридиан»: the CEO greets employees and partners in Russian and then in English (the video showcases AI localization: the same person, the same voice, two languages). Presenter: a confident female CEO of about 45, waist-up, neutral face. Board blocks: hero (title «Меридиан — обращение директора» + presenter), colour palette with 5 HEX swatches, typography (named fonts, H1/H2/body), presenter style, graphic elements, icon style (9 icons: globe, language, handshake, growth chart, office, team, calendar, message, star), infographic examples, decorative elements, footer principles. IMPORTANT: a block «ВЕРТИКАЛЬНЫЕ КАДРЫ 9:16» with 6 phone-shaped frames showing SIX DIFFERENT LAYOUTS: (1) hook without the presenter: huge typography «Этот ролик никто не снимал»; (2) the director waist-up with a name plate «Елена Орлова — генеральный директор»; (3) a big language switch toggle «RU ⇄ EN» in the middle of the frame; (4) split frame: the same director on the left half with a chip «RU» and on the right half with a chip «EN»; (5) the director small inside a framed card plus a minimal world map with five office dots; (6) final: «Одно обращение — на любом языке» with a button «Заказать ролик». Every frame has a subtitle bar at the bottom. All text in Russian (except «EN», «RU» and short English words on EN frames), short and correctly spelled. No real brand names or logos. STYLE B «Глобальный кобальт»: bold, international, dynamic. Background saturated cobalt ultramarine #1636C8 with white #FFFFFF panels; accents: sky blue #8FD3FF, signal orange #FF8A3D, ink #0B1033. Fonts: «Space Grotesk» bold headlines, «Inter» body. Visual language: a world map made of dots, glowing-free flat connection arcs between cities, language chips «RU» / «EN» as rounded pills, split screens with a hard vertical edge, big outlined numbers, flat geometric icons in white and orange, motion-like diagonal stripes. The CEO wears a crisp white shirt and a cobalt blazer, photographed on a plain cobalt backdrop with bright even light. Mood: global, energetic, modern tech-corporate. NO black backgrounds, NO neon glow, NO glassmorphism.
